book.name: MARK
book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn MARK

content: Ohl Peh Mwoator emen
Sises eri pwurehng ketilong nan sinakokeo, wasa me ohl emen me peh mwoator iang mihmi ie.
Aramas ekei me iang mihmi wasao men kadipahki Sises mehkot sapwung, re ahpw mwasamwasahnte Sises ma e pahn ketin kakehlahda me peh mwoatoro rahnen Sapad.
Sises eri mahsanihong me peh mwoatoro, “Keidahdo oh kesihnenda mwohn pokonet.”

E ahpw pil keinemwe rehrail, mahsanih, “Dahme Kosonnedo mweidohng kitail en wia rahnen Sapad? Kitail en kin wia mehkot mwahu de mehkot suwed? Kitail en sewese apwalih mouren aramas de kauwehla?” A irail ahpw nennenlahte sohte mwekid.

Sises ahpw ketin engiengda oh mahmahsenseli pohrail, e ahpw pil ketin kupwurohkihla arail keptakai oh lamalam sapwung. Ih eri mahsanihalahng ohl peh mwoatoro, “Kapahwei pehmwen.” Me peh mwoatoro kapahlahte peho, a peho mwahula douluhl.
Parisi ko eri pedoisang nan sinakokeo pokonpene rehn ekei me uhpalihki Erod; re ahpw kapwungada dahme pahn wiawi pwe re en kemehla Sises.
Lapalahn Pokon ehu ni Oaroahr en Leho
Sises oh sapwellime tohnpadahk ko ahpw ketilahng ni oaroahr en Lehen Kalili, a lapalahn pokon ehu ahpw idawehnla. Aramas ako kohdo sang Kalili, sang Sudia,
sang Serusalem, sang Idumea, sang palio Sordan, oh sang limwahn kahnimw en Dair oh Saidon. Aramas pwukat pokonpene rehn Sises pwehki ar rongadahr soahng kapwuriamwei kan me e kin ketin wiewia.
Ih eri mahsanihong sapwellime tohnpadahk ko re en kaunopada ekis kisin pwohten, me en ketidahng powe, pwe pokono en dehr koaitonla.
Pwe e kin ketin kakehlahda aramas soumwahu tohtohie, ihme re kin koaitonkihla ni irail koaros ar kin men doahke.
Pil aramas me ngehn saut tih pohrail, ni ar kin kilangada, re kin pwupwudi mwowe, weriwer, ndinda, “Komwi me Sapwellimen Kohto!”
A Sises kin ketin kalikedi ngehn saut ko re en dehr kasalehda ihs ih.
Sises ketin Pilada Wahnpoaron Ehk Riemen
Sises eri ketidahla pohn dohl ehu; e ahpw ketin malipedohng reh irail ko me e ketin kupwukupwure me pahn patopato reh.
Ih eri ketin pilada me ehk riemen me e ketin kamwarehkihda wahnpoaron, oh mahsanih, “I pilkumwaildahr pwe kumwail en kin ieiang ie; I pil pahn kadarkumwailewei pwe kumwail en lohkiseli Rongamwahu;
kumwail pil pahn ahneki manaman en kausasang ngehn suwed akan rehn aramas.”
Eri, iet mwaren me ehk riemen me pilipildahr ko: Saimon (Sises ketikihong mware Piter;)
Seims oh Sohn, nein Sepedi (Sises ketikihong mwarara, Poanerkis,

a mouren wehwehn mwar wet mi ni lepin mashen en Pohnpei pwukat; pwurien ikem, de pwuriemwot. Sises ketin kamwarehki nein Sepedi ko mwar wet pwehki ara kin lamalam karuaru de nan kapehd karuaru (pil tehk Luk 9. 54-55). me wehwehki pwurien ikem;)
Andru, Pilip, Pardolomiu, Madiu, Tomas, Seims nein Alpeus, Dadeus, oh Saimon tohn pwihnen Selod,
oh Sudas Iskariot, ohl me pangala Siseso.
Sises oh Peelsepwul
Sises ahpw ketilahsang wasao ketilahng ni tehnpeseo. A lapalahn pokon ehu pil pokonpene wasao, me kahrehda ih oh sapwellime tohnpadahk ko sohla kak konot pwehki sohla ahnsou.
Ni ekei kiseh ko ar rongada met, re ahpw pwarala reh pwe re en ale oh apwalih; pwehki aramas akan ndinda me e iahkalahr.
Ekei sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo ko me kohdihdo sang Serusalem ahpw koasoia me Peelsepwul tiadahr powe. Ekei dene kaunen ngehn suwed kan me kihong Sises manaman en kausasang ngehn suwed rehn aramas.
Ih eri malipepene aramas ako oh mahsanihong irail karasaras kei: “Ia duwen Sehdan eh kak kausala Sehdan?
Ma wehi ehu pahn pwalpeseng wiahda pwihn kei me pahn uhpene nanpwungahr, wehio sohte kak pweida, pwe e pahn mwerpeseng.
Ma peneinei ehu pahn pwalpeseng wiahda pwihn kei me pahn uhpene nanpwungahr, peneineio sohte kak pweida, pwe e pahn mwerpeseng.
Eri, ma wehin Sehdan pahn pwalpeseng wiahda pwihn kei me pahn uhpene nanpwungahr, e sohte kak werei, pwe e pahn mwerpeseng oh imwisekla.
“Sohte me kak wehdpeseng oh pedolong nan imwen aramas kehlail men pwe en kulihasang eh kepwe kan, ma e sohte pahn salihedi mahs me kehlailo; mwuri, e ahpw pahn kak kulih ihmwo.
“Kumwail en ese pwe aramas akan kak ale mahkpen diparail kan koaros, pil dipen lahlahwe.
Ahpw mehmen me pahn lahlahwe Ngehn Sarawi, sohte mwahn kak ale mahkpen dihp wet, pwehki eh wiadahr dihp ehu me sohte mwahn kak lapwada.”
(Sises mahsanih met pwehki ekei ar ndinda me ngehn saut tiadahr powe.)
Inen Sises oh Rie kan
Inen Sises oh rie ko ahpw leledo. Irail eri mi likin ihmwo oh ileklongalahng.
Pokono me mwomwohd kapilpene ahpw patohwanohng, “Komw mwahngih pwe inomwio oh riomwi ko patopato likio, oh re men tuhwong komwi.”
A Sises ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Ihs me inei, oh ihs me riei kan?”
E ahpw mahmahsenseli pohn me mwomwohd mpe ko oh mahsanih, “Iet kan inei oh riei kan.
Pwe aramas akan me kin kapwaiada kupwur en Koht, iei irail me riei oh inei.”
